opening.argument: The video is plainly instructional cooking content centered on preparing spicy egg curry. Its title identifies the subject as an egg-curry recipe, while the narration gives concrete preparation steps: “We have to grind all these spices in a mixer. But we don't have to use water at all.” It then continues with the cooking process, stating, “I have fried the eggs, and now we are going to add lukewarm water in it,” and the visuals show eggs in a pot of curry. Requests to like, comment, subscribe, and share are ordinary channel-engagement prompts. Nothing described requires payment, credentials, investment, or any other financial condition.
